selected_route.rationale: The dominant source-confirmed dev cohort is downstream of semantic admission: 51/223 dev misses already have a direct raw structural accepted pair, and all 18 such rows in the frozen source sample are coherent. The pre-registered held-out gate confirmed 42/142 accepted pairs across six languages. The bounded next intervention is therefore pair-local endpoint coverage through family grouping, not a wider matcher.
selected_route.smallest_sound_invariant: Every direct accepted pair with two distinct, non-nested source sites is covered by a final query family overlapping both endpoints, or by explicit suppression provenance to such a covering family, without inferring unsupported equivalence among transitive component members.

follow_up_issue.title: Preserve accepted-pair endpoint coverage through family folding

pricing.method: #809 alternating same-binary semantic query with warmup, exact output hashes, stage timings, and independent same-binary control
pricing.interpretation: The growth figures assume one new row per uncovered pair and are deliberately loose upper bounds, not an implementation forecast. Issue #817 must reuse covering families and run the actual base/head #809 gate; #816 implements no product head behavior.

rejected_routes.B: Unit extraction is real but smaller and heterogeneous: 4/35 source decisions and 35/223 dev stage rows span pytest metadata, local-item Rust tests, and nested TypeScript tests.
rejected_routes.C: Only 2/35 selected rows are same-unit actionable fragments, and a safe tiny-fragment default policy remains a separate product problem.
rejected_routes.D: No direct pure-callback HOF miss survived source review; the apparent Rust mul/imul pair changes returning versus in-place mutation and cannot justify callback-purity work.
rejected_routes.E: A material mechanism survives: 51 dev and 42 held-out misses already have direct accepted raw pairs, and 18/18 selected accepted-pair rows are source-coherent.

result_dependent_next_action: If #817 restores material dev endpoint coverage and passes hard-negative plus #809 output/runtime gates, merge it, rerun the frontier, and select the next tranche from the remaining misses.

If #817 requires pair explosion, misleading transitive families, or unacceptable default noise/runtime, record a grouping no-go and open the second split-safe precision-label refresh over the remaining 380/1200 unmatched current top-10 positions.
If #817 tracing isolates one narrower deterministic grouping defect, reduce the issue to that defect and do not broaden detector admission.
